CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_LichSuMuaHang AS
SELECT hd.SoHD,hd.MaKH,hd.NgayLap,hd.LoaiHoaDon,hd.TrangThaiHoaDon,
       hd.TrangThaiGiaoHang,hd.TrangThaiThanhToan,hd.KhachPhaiTra,
       COUNT(ct.MaSKU) AS SoMatHang,
       COALESCE(SUM(ct.SoLuong),0) AS SoLuongSanPham
FROM dbo.HoaDon AS hd
LEFT JOIN dbo.ChiTietHoaDon AS ct ON ct.SoHD=hd.SoHD
GROUP BY hd.SoHD,hd.MaKH,hd.NgayLap,hd.LoaiHoaDon,hd.TrangThaiHoaDon,
         hd.TrangThaiGiaoHang,hd.TrangThaiThanhToan,hd.KhachPhaiTra;

modules.name: vw_SanPhamWeb
modules.definition:
/* Read-only convenience views. Monetary history uses invoice details, not current SKU price. */
CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_SanPhamWeb AS
SELECT sp.MaSP,sp.MaLoai,lsp.TenLoai,sp.TenSanPham,sp.MoTa,
       sp.TrangThai,gia.GiaTu,gia.GiaDen,COALESCE(gia.TongTonKho,0) AS TongTonKho
FROM dbo.SanPham AS sp
JOIN dbo.LoaiSanPham AS lsp ON lsp.MaLoai = sp.MaLoai
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN bt.TrangThai = 1 THEN bt.DonGia END) AS GiaTu,
           MAX(CASE WHEN bt.TrangThai = 1 THEN bt.DonGia END) AS GiaDen,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bt.TrangThai = 1 THEN bt.SoLuongTonKho ELSE 0 END),0) AS TongTonKho
    FROM dbo.BienTheSanPham AS bt
    WHERE bt.MaSP=sp.MaSP
) AS gia;
